If you have recently moved into Adams County, Welcome!  Voter registration in the State of Idaho is administered at the county level, with the Adams County Clerk serving as the chief voter registration official for Adams County. Starting July 1 st , 2023, new voters will need to provide one form of photo identification and one form of proof of residency to complete their voter registration process. Click  here  for approved photo identification and proof of residency documents. If your need to update your Idaho voter registration information, you may come into the clerks office during regular business hours with your documents and update your information, or you may also go online to  VoteIdaho.gov  and update your information with the Secretary of States office.  Your application may not be approved until proof of residency is brought into the Adams County Clerks office. Please visit during the open pre-registration time frame listed below, or you can bring it with you on Election Day to your polling location, should proof of residency be required. A letter will be mailed to you informing you of your registration acceptance and polling location. 2026 Pre-Registration Dates: January 1st - May 8th, 2026 May 20th - October 23rd, 2026 2026 Election Calendars 2026 State of Idaho Election Calendar 2026 Adams County Election Calendar For additional election information, visit the  Vote Idaho  website. Interested In Becoming a Poll Worker? If you are interested in becoming a poll worker, please complete the Poll Worker Information Form and email it to Tara Horton , drop it off in our office, or mail it to Adams County Clerk, P.O. Box 48, Council, ID 83612. To be eligible to serve as a poll worker, you must be at least 18 years of age and a U.S. citizen. Opportunities for student poll workers between the ages of 16-17 are available. Please contact our office for information. Voter Registration Polling Places Absentee Voting Taxing Districts Candidate Filing Voter Registration Registration is subject to dates on the Local Elections Calendar.  You are not eligible to vote if you have been convicted of a felony and your rights have not been restored. To register and vote, you must be: A US citizen A resident of Adams County and Idaho for 30 days At least 18 years of age You need to re-register if you have: Changed your name Moved to a different address Not voted within the last 4 years Same Day Registration is available in Idaho which gives you the opportunity to register on Election Day. If you have questions about voter registration, please call the Clerk’s Office at (208) 253-4561 or  visit the Idaho Votes website . Idaho Voter Registration Forms are available in the Clerk’s Office or you can register online by clicking this  link . Click here to see the Adams County Voter Precincts map. Commercial New Meadows, ID 83654 ‍ Absentee Voting The next elections in Adams County will be held on November 3, 2026.  Early voting will begin on October 19th, 2026 thru October 30th, 2026 at the Adams County Building B, 101 Council  ave, Council, ID 83612, from 8:00am-5:00pm.  To receive an absentee ballot by mail, you can fill out a request on  VoteIdaho.gov , or print the  Absentee Request Form , fill it out and mail it to Adams County Clerk, PO Box 48, Council, ID 83612. You may also fax it to (208) 253-4880 or email it to  Teressa Schuyler .  Applications for absentee ballots must be received by 5pm on October 23rd, 2026.  Should you have any questions, please call the Clerk's Office at (208) 253-4561 option 5. Common Requirements for Candidates Must be 21+ years old (offices have different age requirements) Must be a resident of Adams County for a specific amount of time. Must be registered to vote in Adams County. Must be a resident in the taxing district. Must be a resident in the trustee zone. Homeowners exemption at an Adams County residence, if applicable. If you would like more information about a specific office, please contact us at (208) 253-4561 opt. 5, or email Teressa Schuyler at tschuyler@co.adams.id.us.  2026 General Election Offices Available There are no open offices available in Adams County for the 2026 General Election. Filing for Office Beginning August 2026, all candidates must file for candidacy online. Paper candidacy forms will no longer be accepted.  CLICK HERE  to file for candidacy online. Petition of Candidacy forms are still required to be filed at the Adams County Clerks office during the candidate filing window. Forms will be available for the 2027 Elections soon.  Write-In Candidates Write-in candidates must file a Declaration of Intent at the Adams County Clerks office before 5:00p.m. on the filing deadline for the election in which they are running.  Withdrawing as a Candidate Candidates may withdraw their candidacy by submitting the  Withdrawal of Candidacy Form  at the Adams County Clerks office before the withdrawal deadline. ‍ To learn more about running for office,  click here .
